host: x86_64 container, AMD Ryzen 9 5950X, 4 vCPU, 31 GiB (NOT the aarch64 reference host; relative comparisons only, host caveat in lean/initiative.md)
build: cargo build --release (workspace release profile); prefetch variants built by editing src/search/tt/table.rs prefetch() between measurements
solver_rev: plan14 working tree: arm A (TT bucket width 2 -> 4, src/search/tt/table.rs) + examples/portfolio race-end fix; git HEAD a7c3745 is the pre-plan14 shipped state
arm_a: Vec<[TtEntry; 4]>, with_mb entries = (MB*2^20/56).next_power_of_two().max(32), buckets = entries/4; probe linear scan; insert_new empty/stale-lowest then argmin (live, solved, work, generation) with ties to highest index; prefetch 4 hints at byte offsets 0/64/128/192 (pinned by task-3 measurement)

prefetch_measurement.note: m22 default wall: --timeout 20 --outcome-only; m20_fo: --first-outcome --outcome-only --salt 0 --timeout 60 (both at 128 MB). 4-hint pinned; 2-hint variant deleted.

gate_rollout.driver: driver.py (grid 22 cases x 6 salts {0..5} + within-build salt-0 rerun s0r1, resumable)
gate_rollout.comparison: compare.py vs docs/plans/research/measurements/plan12/state/runs.json (shipped HEAD is byte-identical to the plan12 code base, plan13 measurement-only and reverted) -> state/comparison.json
gate_rollout.soundness: S1 within-build determinism (salt-0 rerun byte-identical + same evals; gate invariant 1 renegotiated per plan14 — shipped-trajectory identity N/A), S2 zero decisive-outcome flips, S3 fixture expectations

mechanism_measurement.hook: temporary probe_hook.rs + examples/tt_retention.rs reconstructed from report13 'Method' (ATOMIC_TTPROBE=1 env gate, relaxed-atomic counters, 2^20-slot evicted-key shadow); reverted to byte-identity after measuring (git diff src/search/tt/table.rs identical to the pre-hook arm-A diff; hook files deleted)
mechanism_measurement.cells: m19_fo / m20_fo / m22_fo (control) x salts {0, 3}, extended by salts {1, 4} on the stress cells per the gray-zone protocol; 128 MB, 60 s, one deterministic run per cell
mechanism_measurement.baseline: docs/plans/lean/measurements/plan13/state/results.json (salts 0/3 only; extended salts have no plan13 counterpart and serve as the arm-A noise read)

cases_fens.corpus: frozen plan12 corpus, 22 cases, see driver.py CASES

note: Raw per-cell transcripts live in raw/ (gitignored per the AGENTS.md layout rules; the wall timestamps are parsed into state/runs.json before the .meta.json files were removed). state/ carries every parsed number; the drivers are the reproducible record.
